overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the encryption status (overall and per-table) of the data file designated by structurePath/dataPath.

jointConstraints.rule: Both parameters are wrapped together as one optional group in the doc syntax, implying they must be supplied as a pair (a specific, non-open structure/data file combination) rather than independently.

constraints: dataPath must correspond to the structure file given by structurePath, and must not be the currently-open data file.
